description: Defines the HttpAuthHandlerNegotiate class and its nested Factory class for handling Negotiate HTTP authentication, including platform-specific dependencies and methods for creating and managing authentication tokens.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNegotiate
classes.description: Handles Negotiate authentication protocol, managing token generation and challenge handling.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNegotiate::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HttpAuthHandlerNegotiate instances, managing platform-specific authentication libraries.

methods.name: HttpAuthHandlerNegotiate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the negotiate handler with authentication mechanism, preferences, and resolver.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates if identity is needed for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Checks if explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: spn_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the Service Principal Name for testing purposes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with challenge and SSL info.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenImpl
methods.description: Generates the authentication token based on credentials and request.

methods.name: CreateSPN
methods.description: Creates the Service Principal Name based on server and scheme.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Manages the state machine for authentication steps.

methods.name: DoResolveCanonicalName
methods.description: Resolves the canonical name of the server.

methods.name: GetDelegationType
methods.description: Retrieves the delegation type for the authentication.
